evidence.note: Authentication record declares only UsernamePassword = []; Windows is commented out and no OAuth or key auth exists.
Credential = Extension.CurrentCredential() and CredentialConnectionString maps UID and PWD from Username and Password.
Driver-level UsernamePassword handling is enabled, so the ODBC layer also applies the supplied credentials.
All data access goes through Odbc.DataSource with the ClickHouse ODBC driver connection string.
SqlCapabilities is overridden on top of the BuildOdbcConfig defaults.
SQLGetInfo overrides are declared, including SQL_CONVERT_FUNCTIONS, SQL_SQL92_PREDICATES and SQL_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS.
The server parameter is the ClickHouse host name, which names the connection target.
The optional database parameter names a ClickHouse database inside the target.
The optional options record carries connector settings.

options-fields.text: The options record accepts Timeout (nullable number, non-negative integer), VerifyConnectionEarly (nullable text), SSLMode (nullable text), HugeIntAsString (nullable text) and UseANSIDriver (nullable logical). Any other key raises an error through ValidateOptions.

evidence.note: ValidOptionsMap defines the five accepted option names and their types.
Invalid option keys and invalid values are rejected.
Rows arrive as tables from the ODBC driver through Odbc.DataSource. No JSON, CSV, XML or Excel parsing of returned data exists; Json.Document at line 413 only parses the TestConnection path.
The SQLColumns override only remaps driver metadata DATA_TYPE codes (BOOLEAN, UUID, INT8, INT64). Names and types still come from the driver, so no M types are declared.
Column names and types are supplied by Odbc.DataSource.
The transport is odbc only. There is no Web.Contents or OData.Feed call, so applies_when excludes this connector.
The shared function's type is replaced with DatabaseType, which carries the documentation metadata.
Documentation.Name, LongDescription and Examples are set on the function's table type.
Each parameter has Documentation.FieldCaption and Documentation.FieldDescription.
Documentation.SampleValues are given for server, port, database and options.
Odbc.DataSource lists the navigator's items from the driver at runtime, so the navigation table is discovered from the source.
HierarchicalNavigation = true groups tables into schema folders that open further navigation tables.
The result is filtered to the selected database name.
TestConnection parses the data source path and invokes ClickHouse.Database with the same server, port, database and options parameters.
SqlCapabilities is overridden and passed to Odbc.DataSource.
SQLGetInfo overrides (SQL_SQL92_PREDICATES, SQL_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS, SQL_CONVERT_FUNCTIONS) shape folding.
LimitClauseKind is set from Config_LimitClauseKind, which is LimitOffset, controlling LIMIT and OFFSET folding.
The capabilities reach the ODBC driver through Odbc.DataSource.
Helper loads .pqm code through Extension.Contents and Expression.Evaluate.
Diagnostics.pqm and OdbcConstants.pqm are loaded through Extension.LoadFunction.
Label comes from Extension.LoadString("DataSourceLabel").
ButtonText uses Extension.LoadString for the title and help text.
Icons are loaded from PNG files through Extension.Contents.
The EnableTraceOutput switch is false by default.
Diagnostics.LogValue reaches Diagnostics.Trace only when EnableTraceOutput is true. Otherwise it returns the value unchanged.
Trace output in SQLGetTypeInfo runs only when EnableTraceOutput = true.
Trace output in SQLColumns runs only when EnableTraceOutput is true.
The Diagnostics.Trace call is inside the helper and is reached only through the switched wrapper at ClickHouseConnector.pq line 646.
